continuations.note: Exercise 21(b) completes the q-adic normality generalization and its law-of-large-numbers hint.

key_objects.name_zh: 第 6 章导论：Brownian 运动
key_objects.description: 把 Brownian path 视为适当缩放的随机游走路径的极限；核心分析问题是诱导路径测度向 Wiener measure 的弱收敛，并应用于 Dirichlet 问题。

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian 出界概率与调和测度
key_objects.name_en: Brownian exit probability as harmonic measure
key_objects.description: 对有界区域 R、内部点 x 与边界集合 E，从 x 出发的 Brownian path 首次离开 R 时落在 E 的概率对应关于 x 的 harmonic measure。

key_objects.name_zh: 停止时与强 Markov 性质的导论动机
key_objects.name_en: motivation for stopping times and the strong Markov property
key_objects.description: 首达边界时间是基本 stopping time；重启于 stopping time 后仍得到等价 Brownian motion，是后续 Dirichlet 问题应用的关键。

key_objects.name_zh: 缩放并线性插值的随机游走过程 S_t^(N)
key_objects.name_en: rescaled linearly interpolated random walk S_t^(N)

key_objects.name_zh: 随机游走过程趋向 Brownian motion 的目标陈述
key_objects.name_en: target convergence from rescaled random walks to Brownian motion
key_objects.qualification: later formalized as weak convergence of induced path measures, not pointwise a.e. convergence

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian motion 的三条刻画性质 B-1/B-2/B-3
key_objects.name_en: Brownian motion axioms B-1, B-2, B-3
properties: B-2 increments B_{t+h}-B_t are mean-zero Gaussian with covariance hI
B-3 sample paths are almost surely continuous

key_objects.name_zh: 从原点出发的连续路径空间 P
key_objects.description: P consists of continuous p:[0,∞)→R^d with p(0)=0.

key_objects.name_zh: 路径空间上的坐标过程 B~_t

key_objects.description: 路径空间 P 上的概率测度 W，使坐标过程满足 Brownian motion 的 B-1/B-2/B-3；其存在等价于 Brownian motion 的存在，后文还将证明唯一性。

key_objects.name_zh: 缩放随机游走在路径空间上诱导的测度 μ_N
key_objects.name_en: path-space measure induced by the rescaled random walk

key_objects.name_zh: 路径测度 μ_N 弱收敛到 Wiener 测度
key_objects.name_en: weak convergence of random-walk path measures to Wiener measure
key_objects.statement: μ_N converges weakly to W as N→∞.

key_objects.name_zh: 路径空间 P 上的紧集一致收敛度量 d_n 与 d
key_objects.name_en: metrics d_n and d on path space P

exercises.name_zh: 平稳过程可表示为 shift 轨道并适用遍历定理
exercises.name_en: stationary processes as shift processes and applicability of the ergodic theorem
exercises.source_summary: A stationary process has the same joint distribution as {g_0(τ^n(y))}; hence the ergodic theorem applies.

exercises.name_zh: 大数定律中可积条件的尖锐性
exercises.name_en: sharpness of the integrability hypothesis in the law of large numbers
exercises.source_summary: For iid {f_n} with ∫|f_0|=∞, the averages fail to converge a.e.; hint uses independent A_n={|f_n|>n} and Exercise 20.

exercises.name_zh: 条件期望的两个具体例子
exercises.name_en: two concrete examples of conditional expectation
exercises.source_summary: (a) average on partition atoms A_n; (b) integrate out the X_2 coordinate on a product space.

exercises.name_zh: L2 有界终值 martingale 的 L2 收敛
exercises.name_en: L2 convergence of a martingale generated by an L2 terminal value
exercises.source_summary: If s_n=E_n(s_∞) with s_∞∈L2 then {s_n} converges in L2; hint uses orthogonality of increments.

exercises.name_zh: martingale 的 Lp 收缩与反向终值表示及 p=1 反例
exercises.name_en: Lp contraction, terminal-value representation, and the p=1 failure
exercises.source_summary: (a) ||E_n s∞||_p≤||s∞||_p; (b) uniformly Lp-bounded martingales, p>1, have terminal s∞; (c) conclusion may fail at p=1.

exercises.name_zh: 可积终值 martingale 的 L1 收敛及 A∞ 可测判别
exercises.name_en: L1 convergence and A∞-measurability criterion for terminal martingales
exercises.source_summary: s_n=E_n(s∞), s∞∈L1: s_n converges in L1; convergence to s∞ iff s∞ is measurable with respect to A∞=∨A_n.

exercises.name_zh: 终值 martingale 的最大不等式与 Lp 极大函数界
exercises.name_en: terminal martingale maximal inequality and Lp maximal bound

exercises.name_zh: R^d 值 martingale 的条件期望与最大不等式
exercises.source_summary: Verify |s_k|≤E_k|s_n| and the vector-valued maximal inequality, using inner products with unit vectors.

exercises.name_zh: R^d 上 dyadic 条件期望与 Hardy-Littlewood 最大函数的比较
exercises.name_en: dyadic conditional expectations on R^d versus the Hardy-Littlewood maximal function
exercises.source_summary: Extend martingale maximal inequality; prove sup E_n f≤c f* for f≥0; show converse pointwise bound fails but a distributional substitute holds.

exercises.name_zh: 特征函数收敛、弱收敛与开集/区间概率收敛的等价
exercises.name_en: equivalent criteria for weak convergence of probability measures
exercises.source_summary: For probability measures μ_N,ν on R^d, relate characteristic functions, weak convergence, interval convergence in R, and open-set convergence under regularity assumptions.

exercises.name_zh: 多维 Gaussian 测度的 Fourier 变换计算
exercises.name_en: Fourier transform of a multivariate Gaussian measure
exercises.source_summary: For positive definite symmetric σ, verify ν_{σ²} has transform exp(-2π²|σξ|²) by diagonalizing σ.

exercises.name_zh: d 维随机游走的中心极限定理极限分布
exercises.name_en: limiting distribution of the d-dimensional random walk under sqrt(n) scaling
exercises.source_summary: Find the limit distribution of s_n/n^{1/2} for the d-dimensional random walk of §2.6.

exercises.name_zh: 低维随机游走几乎处处无穷多次访问任意格点
exercises.name_en: low-dimensional random walk visits every lattice point infinitely often a.e.
exercises.source_summary: For d=1 or 2 and fixed k∈Z^d, show P{s_n=k infinitely often}=1.

exercises.name_zh: 高维随机游走几乎处处逃向无穷远
exercises.name_en: high-dimensional random walk escapes to infinity a.e.
exercises.source_summary: For d≥3 prove |s_n|→∞ almost everywhere; hint reduces to fixed-radius liminf events and recurrence at a lattice point.

problems.name_zh: 非对称 Bernoulli 测度的 Riesz 乘积表示及奇异性
problems.name_en: Riesz-product representation and singularity of biased Bernoulli measure
problems.source_summary: Under D:Z_2^∞→[0,1], describe μ_p by partial products F_N and prove monotonicity, normalization, uniform convergence, μ_p=dF, and complete singularity when p≠1/2.

problems.name_zh: lacunary Fourier 级数与 Walsh-Paley/Rademacher 类比
problems.name_en: lacunary Fourier series and the Walsh-Paley/Rademacher analogy
problems.source_summary: For Σc_k e^{i2^kθ}: L2 implies all finite Lp; integrable implies L2; L∞ iff Σ|c_k|<∞; hence Theorem 1.7(a) fails at p=∞.

problems.name_zh: 一般独立非同分布中心极限定理的 Lindeberg 条件
problems.name_en: general central limit theorem under a Lindeberg-type condition
problems.source_summary: Independent mean-zero square-integrable f_k with total variance S_n² and a tail second-moment condition have normalized sums converging weakly to N(0,1).

problems.name_zh: 独立同分布随机变量和的重对数律
problems.source_summary: For iid mean-zero variance-one f_n and s_n=Σf_k, limsup s_n/(2n log log n)^{1/2}=1 a.e.

problems.name_zh: 单位球面方向均匀随机飞行
problems.name_en: random flight with uniformly distributed directions on the sphere
problems.source_summary: For independent unit-sphere directions: connect the step characteristic function with Bessel functions, find covariance, and find the limiting distribution of s_n/√n.

boundary.continues: Chapter 6 §2 Technical Preliminaries: properties of metric d, Borel/cylindrical sets, then Lemma 2.1.
